analysis.headline: USD/KRW drops 5.2 KRW to 1,333.0 on KOSPI 5,067 rally; NDF settles at 1,333.7
analysis.summary: USD/KRW tumbled 5.2 KRW to close at 1,333.0 in Seoul (ECB ref 1,332.33) as KOSPI surged 1.99% to 5,067.44 on semiconductor gains alongside exporter dollar sales. Overnight, 1M NDF ended at 1,333.7 even as hawkish FOMC minutes lifted the US Dollar Index to 103.78.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW falls to 1,461.3 as hawkish FOMC minutes push EUR/USD to 1.0968
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW dropped to around 1,461.3 (ECB ref 1,461.30) as hawkish October FOMC minutes—revealing two dissents for a 25bp hike—lifted DXY to 103.78. EUR/USD broke below 1.1000 to 19-month lows near 1.0968, compounding the downward pull from Seoul's lower USD/KRW close.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW eases to 835.7 per 100 JPY as FOMC minutes keep USD/JPY near 159.4
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW declined to around 8.36 KRW per JPY (~835.7 per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.357). Hawkish FOMC minutes and elevated US yields kept USD/JPY pinned near 159.4–160.0 amid intervention watch, while KRW's rebound to 1,333.0 in Seoul pulled the yen cross lower.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW drops to 1,754.5 after softer UK CPI trims December BoE hike bets
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW fell over 8 KRW to around 1,754.5 (ECB ref 1,754.47). UK October CPI rose 3.6% YoY, below the 3.7% consensus with core steady at 2.8%, trimming odds of a December BoE hike toward 80%. GBP/USD slid near 1.3170 while stronger KRW deepened the cross drop.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW dips just below 200 to 199.8 on won rally despite firm PBOC fix
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW slipped below the 200 mark to around 199.8 (ECB ref 199.83). Although the PBOC strengthened its daily USD/CNY fixing to 6.7118 from 6.7132 to project stability, a 5.2 KRW drop in Seoul USD/KRW on exporter sales and KOSPI reclaiming 5,000 pulled the cross lower.

AUD.headline: AUD slides to 896.8 KRW as hawkish FOMC minutes and KRW rally weigh
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar fell to 896.8 KRW as hawkish FOMC minutes pushed AUD/USD near 0.6731 alongside Seoul's stronger won.

CAD.headline: CAD slips to 931.4 KRW on 3.3% WTI crude drop to $83.26 and KRW strength
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar eased to 931.4 KRW as US inventory builds sent WTI crude down 3.3% to $83.26 and USD/KRW fell in Seoul.

CHF.headline: CHF retreats to 1,581.0 KRW as post-FOMC dollar surge meets firmer KRW
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc dropped to 1,581.0 KRW as DXY climbing to 103.78 weighed on CHF against USD while KRW rallied in Seoul.

CNY.headline: CNY dips under 200 to 199.8 KRW on won surge despite firmer 6.7118 PBOC fix
CNY.brief: The Chinese yuan slipped just below 200 to 199.8 KRW as Seoul's 5.2 KRW drop in USD/KRW outweighed a firmer 6.7118 PBOC fixing.

EUR.headline: EUR drops to 1,461.3 KRW as hawkish FOMC minutes sink EUR/USD to 1.0968
EUR.brief: The euro fell to 1,461.3 KRW as two hike dissents in FOMC minutes pushed EUR/USD below 1.1000 to 19-month lows near 1.0968.

GBP.headline: GBP falls to 1,754.5 KRW after 3.6% UK CPI miss trims December BoE bets
GBP.brief: Sterling dropped to 1,754.5 KRW after UK CPI printed 3.6% vs 3.7% expected, trimming December BoE hike odds toward 80%.

HKD.headline: HKD eases to 169.8 KRW tracking Seoul USD/KRW's 5.2 KRW drop to 1,333.0
HKD.brief: Pegged tightly near 7.847 per USD, the Hong Kong dollar slipped to 169.8 KRW in line with Seoul's 5.2 KRW drop in USD/KRW.

JPY.headline: JPY eases to 835.7 per 100 JPY as FOMC keeps USD/JPY pinned near 159.4
JPY.brief: The yen slipped to 835.7 KRW per 100 JPY as hawkish FOMC minutes held USD/JPY near 159.4 while KRW jumped in Seoul.

KRW.headline: KRW rallies 5.2 KRW to 1,333.0 on KOSPI 5,067 rebound and exporter sales
KRW.brief: The won strengthened 5.2 KRW to 1,333.0 as KOSPI reclaimed 5,067.44 (+1.99%) on chip gains and 1M NDF settled at 1,333.7.

USD.headline: USD drops 5.2 KRW to 1,333.0 in Seoul despite DXY rising to 103.78
USD.brief: Despite hawkish FOMC minutes lifting DXY to 103.78, USD/KRW fell 5.2 KRW to 1,333.0 in Seoul (ECB ref 1,332.33; NDF 1,333.7).
